_meta.purpose: Nutrient requirements per animal class, for ration ADEQUACY checks (MCS-23). Consumed read-only by scripts/ration_check.py.
_meta.owned_by: operator/vet — the requirement values come from the NRC 'Nutrient Requirements of Small Ruminants' (2007) tables for the animal's class, weight, and production stage. This tool AUTHORS NO requirement values; they are null until entered from NRC, and an adequacy check on a null requirement reports 'unknown', never 'adequate'.
_meta.dmi_note: dmi_pct_bodyweight is a documented RULE OF THUMB (dry-matter intake as a fraction of body weight: ~2% maintenance up to ~4% peak lactation), tunable — NOT a substitute for the NRC intake table. It is used only to estimate expected daily dry-matter intake from real body weights; nutrient adequacy still needs the NRC requirement values.
_meta.nutrients: tdn_pct (energy, % of DM), cp_pct (crude protein, % of DM), ca_pct (calcium), p_pct (phosphorus). Enter from NRC for each class in use.

schema_per_class.dmi_pct_bodyweight: rule-of-thumb DMI as fraction of body weight
schema_per_class.tdn_pct: NRC TDN requirement, % of DM (null until entered)
schema_per_class.cp_pct: NRC crude-protein requirement, % of DM (null until entered)
schema_per_class.ca_pct: NRC calcium requirement, % of DM (null until entered)
schema_per_class.p_pct: NRC phosphorus requirement, % of DM (null until entered)
